vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral
iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.

While Greece alone won't materially impact near-term results, the strategic move supports long-term loan growth, advisory fees, and capital-markets revenues.

It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.

top.summary: Dropbox (DBX) gained 1.46% in the latest session, outperforming the S&P 500, but holds a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell) rating. reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+5.2% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +5.2%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

reasons.en: within ~1σ of the call wall (420) — mechanical resistance overhead
reasons.zh: 接近 Call 墙（420）约 1σ 以内 — 上方有机械阻力

reasons.en: armed at the upper gamma band — a close above releases the move up
reasons.zh: 在上沿 Gamma 带蓄势 — 收盘突破即向上释放

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: calls modestly richer than puts (+0.8 vol pts vs peers) — mild bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨略贵于看跌（+0.8 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -8.5 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -8.5 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

Despite the Germany exit, HSBC continues investing in its global Wholesale Transaction Banking franchise, which saw fee income rise 4% to $6.1 billion.

Growth is driven by stricter environmental regulations, corporate sustainability commitments, and increasing demand across aerospace, automotive, and industrial sectors. Key opportunities include EV lightweighting, Asia-Pacific expansion, and strategic partnerships with OEMs.

top.title: Stock Market News for Sep 11, 2026
top.summary: U.S. stock markets declined on Thursday as surging oil prices and inflation data drove investor concerns about potential Fed rate hikes. Brent crude jumped 6.34% to $107.63 and WTI rose 6.69% to $102.48, both exceeding $100 for the first time since May. Rising Treasury yields and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East further pressured equities, with the Dow, Nasdaq, and S&P 500 all closing in the red. Markets are now pricing in a 70% probability of a Fed rate increase at next week's policy meeting.

top.title: Smart Metering in Latin America and the Caribbean - 3rd Edition Market Analysis and Forecasts to 2030
top.summary: Smart metering in Latin America and the Caribbean is experiencing significant growth, with the installed base of smart electricity meters forecast to increase from 17.3 million units in 2024 to 61.3 million units by 2030, representing a 23.5% compound annual growth rate. Brazil and Mexico are leading the market, accounting for over 65% of annual meter demand. Key drivers include grid modernization efforts, electricity theft reduction, and supportive government policies. Major utilities like Cemig, COPEL, Enel, and CPFL are expanding investments in advanced metering infrastructure.

top.title: IonQ Advances Quantum Computing With Superion 256: What's Ahead?
top.summary: IonQ has launched Superion 256, its sixth-generation quantum computing platform featuring integrated electronic qubit control and 256 qubits. The company achieved significant manufacturing improvements with SkyWater, reducing design cycles from 9 to 2 months and increasing wafer lot production 12-fold. The system is designed for data center deployment and scales to millions of qubits, with customer deliveries expected in 2027.

top.summary: Smart metering in Latin America and the Caribbean is experiencing significant growth, with the installed base of smart electricity meters forecast to increase from 17.3 million units in 2024 to 61.3 million units by 2030, representing a 23.5% compound annual growth rate. Brazil and Mexico are leading the market, accounting for over 65% of annual meter demand. Key drivers include grid modernization efforts, electricity theft reduction, and supportive government policies. Major utilities like Cemig, COPEL, Enel, and CPFL are expanding investments in advanced metering infrastructure.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

Growth is driven by increasing industrial automation, rising demand for low-VOC and eco-friendly formulations, and expanding electric vehicle production. North America leads with 32.40% market share, while Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region at 6.55% CAGR. Solvent-based degreasers dominate with 47.60% market share, though water-based alternatives are growing rapidly at 6.30% CAGR.

The company is deepening partnerships on Bushmaster Chain Guns production, IBCS command systems, and the E-2D Hawkeye platform, positioning itself to benefit from Europe's focus on strengthening defense capabilities and domestic manufacturing.

top.title: IonQ Advances Quantum Computing With Superion 256: What's Ahead?
top.summary: IonQ has launched Superion 256, its sixth-generation quantum computing platform featuring integrated electronic qubit control and 256 qubits. The company achieved significant manufacturing improvements with SkyWater, reducing design cycles from 9 to 2 months and increasing wafer lot production 12-fold. The system is designed for data center deployment and scales to millions of qubits, with customer deliveries expected in 2027.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -3.7 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -3.7 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: X Pay is live on mainnet
top.summary: X Pay has launched a payment gateway that enables any API or software to charge for individual HTTP requests and settle in USDC on Base mainnet. The service eliminates traditional payment barriers like accounts, API keys, and subscriptions by leveraging the x402 standard and stablecoins, allowing economically viable micropayments for the first time. The x402 standard, contributed by Coinbase and managed by the Linux Foundation, has already processed over 169 million payments across 590,000 buyers and 100,000 sellers.

top.summary: X Pay has launched a payment gateway that enables any API or software to charge for individual HTTP requests and settle in USDC on Base mainnet. The x402 standard, contributed by Coinbase and managed by the Linux Foundation, has already processed over 169 million payments across 590,000 buyers and 100,000 sellers.

The lawsuit claims Planet Fitness' updated marketing strategy failed to resonate with its target demographic, resulting in significant headwinds in net member joins and rendering fiscal 2026 guidance unachievable. Investors with losses exceeding $100,000 are encouraged to secure counsel before the September 14, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline.

top.summary: BigBear.ai (BBAI) has declined 29.4% over three months despite reporting 13% Q2 revenue growth to $36.7M and a strong $409.8M cash position. The company faces headwinds from modest growth relative to AI opportunity, persistent losses with adjusted EBITDA deteriorating to -$11.6M, heavy dependence on government contract conversion, and intense competition from larger players like Palantir. While the company benefits from rising AI demand and has strategic M&A plans, investors remain cautious about profitability and execution risks.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -3.9 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -3.9 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -8.8 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -8.8 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。
